explanations.text:
[update t3code on signal](UPDATE_T3.md):
    use [same t3.service node version from nvm](UPDATE_T3.md:Use the node of t3.service)
    [install the newest t3](UPDATE_T3.md:Install the newest t3) with npm install -g t3@latest
    [check with npm ls -g t3](UPDATE_T3.md:Check the installed version) that the new version is installed
    [restart t3.service with a one-time systemd timer](UPDATE_T3.md:Restart t3.service):
        sudo systemd-run --on-active=20 /bin/systemctl restart t3.service

[after the restart, check](UPDATE_T3.md:Check after the restart):
    systemctl status t3.service shows active (running)
    logs with no error

verbatim.origin:
update t3code on signal:
    use same t3.service node version from nvm
    install the newest t3 with npm install -g t3@latest
    check with npm ls -g t3 that the new version is installed
    restart t3.service with a one-time systemd timer:
        sudo systemd-run --on-active=20 /bin/systemctl restart t3.service

after the restart, check:
    systemctl status t3.service shows active (running)
    logs with no error
